findings.text: non-blocking: The node's declared write paths are reckon/crew/review.py, the evidence fragment and the figures directory; this test file is outside all three, so the diff writes a path the fence did not grant. The plan section it implements (docs/plans/every-review-is-kept-as-a-committed-record.html:193) names this test file as a write path, so the brief's fence was under-specified rather than the worker overreaching, and the manifest states it and asks for accept-path ratification; the coordinator should ratify or fold this before the node is treated as in-scope.

non-blocking: The recorded baseline_suite is red (3 failed, EXIT=1) because the pre-existing test's fixture manifest predated the messages_received delivery requirement, so the base arm measures a broken test rather than a healthy base. The behaviour §22 asks the negative control to show cannot occur at this base revision, since the delivery-side refusal predates it; the worker substituted a mutation at base, which is the honest reproduction of the pre-fix behaviour, but a later reader must not read the base arm as evidence that the code under test is what differs.
